title: Rails Forms & Views
intro: Rails views and forms interview questions test whether you understand the presentation layer that delivers HTML to the browser. This module covers ERB syntax (<%=  %> outputs and escapes, <% %> executes without output, <%# %> is a comment), layouts and the yield keyword for content injection, partials with render and the locals option for passing data, form_with and how it generates CSRF tokens automatically, the common view helpers (link_to, button_to, image_tag, number_to_currency, pluralize, humanize), content_for and yield with a named block for page-specific content, flash display in layouts, iterating with .each in ERB templates, and why automatic HTML escaping in ERB protects against XSS. All examples are beginner-level — no decorators, no ViewComponent.
